column1: # Root-cause labels for Sherlock 2025-05-lend-audit-contest at commit 713372a1ccd8090ead836ca6b1acf92e97de4679.
# Same rc iff one minimal code fix at one site removes both exploit paths. Paths are relative to Lend-V2/.

column5: CoreRouter.borrow zeroes borrowAmount when the caller's stored borrowIndex is 0, so a first-time borrower's collateral check becomes require(collateral >= 0) and a zero-collateral account borrows against the router's pooled collateral
column6: src/LayerZero/CoreRouter.sol:157 ternary yields 0 when currentBorrow.borrowIndex==0, gate at :161

column5: liquidateBorrowAllowedInternal re-multiplies the already interest-accrued borrowed sum by the borrowIndex ratio, inflating debt so a liquidator can pass the shortfall check against a solvent borrower and seize collateral
column6: src/LayerZero/CoreRouter.sol:347-348 borrowedAmount = borrowed * borrowIndex() / borrowBalance.borrowIndex
